name: An Evening of Holiday Magic at Butler Town Center
paras: Butler Center hosts An Evening of Holiday Magic on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 4:30 to 7:30 PM at the Butler Town Center Piazza in Gainesville.

Santa and Mrs. Claus greet families while local vendors set up around the piazza and local musical and dance companies perform. Children can make holiday crafts, get their faces painted and play in a bounce house.
The evening ends with a tree lighting for families and friends gathered at the piazza, and the date is posted on the Butler Center website under its events list.
Butler Center describes the night as a way to gather with family and friends for holiday cheer, so the schedule suits a relaxed visit rather than a timed show.
tip: Arrive before the tree lighting so the kids can fit in crafts, face painting and the bounce house.

name: Thornebrook Holiday Market with Santa Photos
paras: Shoppes at Thornebrook turns its Gainesville courtyard into a winter wonderland for the Thornebrook Holiday Market on Friday, December 4, 2026, from 5 to 8 PM.
Local shops and vendors set up alongside food trucks, and families can have their photo taken with Santa.
The market is held at 2441 NW 43rd Street, and the shopping center runs a vendor application for makers who want a booth.
The center lists the night as a way to herald the holiday season, with the courtyard decorated before the shops and food trucks open their doors to the crowd.
tip: Plan to eat from the food trucks and save time for the photo line with Santa.

name: Nana's Gingerbread Contest and Snowy Block Party in Newberry
host: the City of Newberry events calendar
venue: Mentholee Norfleet Municipal Building and Barry Park
paras: The City of Newberry holds its annual Nana's Gingerbread Decorating Contest at 4 PM on Saturday, December 19, 2026, at the Mentholee Norfleet Municipal Building. Friends, families and coworkers build gingerbread houses to compete, and the city's event page has a link to enter.
At 4:30 PM the celebration moves to Barry Park for the Snowy Block Party, with snow flurries, music and a view of the Christmas parade as it comes through downtown.
tip: Enter the gingerbread house contest through the link on the city's event page before the 4 PM start.

name: Christmas From the Hart at Hart Springs Park
paras: Hart Springs Park in Bell lights up for Christmas From the Hart on the third weekend of the series, Saturday, December 19, 2026, from 6 to 9 PM. Admission is free.
The park is decorated in colorful festive lights that fill the grounds like a Christmas wonderland.
Little ones can visit the Santa workshop for Christmas activities and a cup of hot chocolate, which makes this a stop with something to do for every age in the family.
A printed flyer for the third weekend is linked from the park event page and shows the free admission notice.
tip: Bring the little ones early for the Santa workshop and a cup of hot chocolate.

name: Light Up Tioga at Tioga Town Center
host: the Tioga Town Center events page
paras: Tioga Town Center in Newberry hosts Light Up Tioga on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 5 to 8 PM, and the event benefits United Way of North Central Florida.

A rooftop setup from ThemeWorks lets families pose for a photo with Santa and climb up to the chimney. Naughty and Nice lanes, face painting, balloon artists, festive characters, music from Kiss 105.3, a holiday market and food trucks fill the town center before the tree lighting.

Guests are invited to donate new, unwrapped books and toys to the Fill the Sleigh drive, and off-site parking with a shuttle about every 15 minutes runs from CAMPUS USA Credit Union Headquarters at 14007 NW 1st Rd.
tip: Bring a new, unwrapped toy or book for the Fill the Sleigh drive and use the shuttle if parking is full.
